_lessons: Ad offer IDs from list_ad_offers rotate between calls and, when placed, trigger a FRESH opportunity accept. The ad network caps how many opportunities a publication can hold accepted at once; placing fresh offer IDs on 2026-10-23 failed with 'can not accept any more opportunities'. Fix: the network auto-accepts a rolling set of opportunities. Use list_ad_opportunities(status='accepted') and embed those already-accepted opportunity UUIDs directly, which does not trigger a new accept. Rank accepted opportunities by payout_per_click_cents and pick distinct advertisers with send_by after the target send time.

beehiiv email_settings keys on save_post/edit_post are email_subject_line and email_preview_text (not subject_line / preview_text). Passing the wrong keys silently defaults the subject to the title and preview to the subtitle.
